title: 小型氧气罐无法补充
description: 无法补充小型氧气罐，用普通泵填充会爆炸。
evidence: there is no way to replenish small oxygen canisters, if you try to fill them up with normal pumps they just blow up, because they pump more pressure in one tick than that poor alluminum bottle can take
